title: Three Pulse Trial
next_chapter_hook: Before his father's phantom dissipated, he left behind these words: "When the three pulses unite as one, the location of the fourth layer of seals within the Heavenly Secrets will reveal itself to you." Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his pupils constricting—the location of the fourth layer of seals had been hidden deep within their bloodline all along.

text.content: As dawn broke, Chen Nian led Chen Ji and Ye Qing to the Forbidden Grounds at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Perpetually shrouded in mist with ancient trees towering overhead, ordinary disciples had no idea that behind the Third Peak lay such an isolated realm. "Big brother, this is it." Chen Nian stopped, her jade-like hand gently brushing over a moss-covered boulder. "Before he left, Father inscribed the method to open it into my bloodline memory." She turned her head, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. "I never imagined that the day this would actually be used would come ten years later."

Chen Ji gazed at the mist-shrouded cliff face, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve faintly burning. Ever since learning of Ling Yuan's connection to his father, an inexplicable sense of urgency had sprouted in his heart. The former sect master had hidden too deeply, endured too long—this patience sent chills down his spine. Standing beside him, Ye Qing's Demonic Path Saintess aura had greatly收敛, replaced by a rare gravity. "Young Master Chen, are you certain you want to let us two outsiders enter your father's private trial?" Her voice was low. "If there are secrets within that shouldn't be known by outsiders..."

"Since this is cooperation, we must show sincerity." Chen Ji cut her off, a faint smile curving his lips. "Besides, if Lady Ye truly wished to窥探 secrets, with your cultivation, Little Nian and I combined couldn't necessarily stop you." He turned to face Ye Qing seriously. "I choose to trust you because I know the taste of being used by one's own kin. Your situation in the Holy Sect—I am not unaware of it." Ye Qing's eyelashes trembled slightly, and for the first time, a subtle fluctuation appeared in those usually cold eyes.

dialogue.content: "Big brother, the entrance to the secret realm is right here." Chen Nian took a deep breath and pressed her palm against the boulder. Pale golden light spread from her palm, flowing along the barely visible patterns on the stone wall. "The bloodline印记Father left only recognizes the three direct bloodlines of the Chen family. When he set thisrestriction, he probably never imagined that big brother and second brother would reunite in this way." Her voice carried a hint of bitterness. "This secret realm was originally set up for us three siblings to grow together..."

text.content: The boulder quaked violently as a deep fissure slowly opened in the cliff face, revealing a staircase descending downward. On both sides of the stairs, unknown luminous ores were embedded, reflecting the surroundings like an underwater world, shimmering with an undercurrent of eeriness. Chen Ji looked up—the end of the staircase revealed a stone gate's outline, bearing a符文he knew all too well—identical to the marking on the Tianji Record Fragment. "Father... how much more did he hide from me?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, the unease in his heart growing stronger.

choice.prompt: Before entering the secret realm, Chen Ji faced a choice: should he let Ye Qing scout ahead to ensure safety, or should all three enter together, showing true trust?

choices.description: Choosing to place Ye Qing in the middle with the three siblings guarding around, using bloodline bonds as a link to face the unknown together. Demonstrating absolute trust in an ally.
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline resonance enhanced, sibling tacit understanding improved
choices.risk_hint: If ambushed, all three fall into危局 simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, making a decision that even slightly surprised Ye Qing: "No need to scout ahead. We go in together." He extended his hand to Chen Nian. "Little Nian, you walk in the middle. Lady Ye..." He paused. "If you would kindly walk at my side, if anything unusual happens, your Demonic Path mist can also conceal our movements." Ye Qing gazed at him deeply, then nodded. The three stepped side by side into the fissure, the winding staircase stretching downward before them, as if leading to some forgotten ancient world.

dialogue.content: "Young Master Chen, you are比我想象中更... unique." Ye Qing's voice was low. "In the Holy Sect, trust is the most luxurious thing." She slightly turned her head, that cold and beautiful face appearing especially soft under the ore light. "May this trust not become your weakness."

choices.description: Letting Ye Qing scout ahead with Demonic Path mist, entering only after confirming safety. Though cautious, may seem insufficiently trusting of the ally.

text.content: "Caution is never wrong." Chen Ji spoke, gesturing for Ye Qing to go ahead. Ye Qing said nothing, a faint black mist rising around her as it spread like a living thing into the depths of the staircase. After a moment, she opened her eyes. "There's no danger within a hundred zhang ahead, but... some kind of power is watching us." Chen Ji frowned. "Watching?" Chen Nian took up the explanation: "That's the本能 of the trial secret realm. It's recording the entrants' bloodline information and character assessments."

dialogue.content: "Let it watch then." Ye Qing withdrew her demonic energy, saying casually, "My aura has been concealed by the mist anyway. Young Master Chen's Tianji Record... should be暂时 safe for now." Her gaze toward Chen Ji carried a more profound meaning. "You truly are a cautious person. If the Holy Sect's scouts were half as careful, they wouldn't have suffered so many losses."

text.content: The three descended the staircase slowly, the air growing more humid, carrying a faint sandalwood fragrance. More and more符文 began appearing on the stone walls on both sides—those characters were identical to those on the Tianji Record, yet bore subtle differences. "These are..." Chen Ji stopped to examine them carefully. "Father wasn't merely researching the Tianji Record itself, but the things behind it." An inkling formed in his heart—the Tianji Record Fragment might only be the tip of the iceberg.

Finally, the three arrived before the stone gate. The gate stood approximately three zhang high and over two zhang wide, its surface covered in complex formation patterns. At the exact center of the gate, three fist-sized cavities were embedded, arranged in a triangle. "This is a Blood Resonance Formation." Chen Nian explained. "The three siblings must simultaneously drip blood into them for the gate to open. Father said this was to ensure only those with Chen bloodline could enter... and to prevent outsiders from stealing what lies within." She paused, glancing at Ye Qing. "Including my research on Heavenly Fate Key over these years."

dialogue.content: "Wait—" Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his gaze falling on an unremarkable carving in the corner of the stone gate. It was a line of small characters, the handwriting already faded but still distinguishable: "Ji'er, if you can read these words, it means your father is no longer among the living." Chen Ji's body froze. Chen Nian and Ye Qing both fell silent, not daring to disturb him. "The Three Pulse Trial cannot be opened unless facing a life-or-death situation." The handwriting continued. "But your father hopes more that you can find the answers you seek here."

text.content: Chen Ji's fist slowly clenched. His father's handwriting, he knew it better than anything. Those steady yet restrained strokes, each line imbued with an unshakable composure. But the calm resignation between the lines, entrusting posthumous affairs, struck his heart as if something had violently struck it. "Brother..." Chen Nian called softly, her eyes already reddened. Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging emotions. "Drip the blood." His voice was calm to the point of coldness, only the slightly trembling fingertips revealing the turbulence within.

Three blood threads simultaneously fell into the groove, and the Blood Resonance Formation abruptly blazed with blinding golden light. That radiance flowed along the formation patterns on the stone door, as if some ancient life was awakening. The stone door emitted a low rumble, and cracks sealed for countless ages slowly parted, a breath of air carrying both decay and fragrance rushing forth. "It's open." Ye Qing murmured. "Inside... it's very quiet." Chen Ji looked up to see that beyond the stone door lay a vast space, with a massive altar standing in the center, and above it floated a yellowed jade slip.

"What is that?" Ye Qing narrowed his eyes. Before Chen Ji could answer, a ring of light suddenly glowed on the ground beneath them, and then three illusory figures rose from the ring, separating the three of them. "Bloodline Trial, begins." An ancient yet majestic voice echoed through the space. "First trial, test of trust. Three bloodlines united, only then may you pass." Chen Ji discovered his body was bound by an invisible force, unable to approach Chen Nian and Ye Qing. The scenery before him began to distort, as if immersed in a dream from which there was no waking.

choice.prompt: The trial space's trial descended—before Chen Ji appeared an illusion: Ling Yuan was torturing Chen Nian, demanding Chen Ji hand over the Tianji Record Fragment. At this moment, how should he choose?

choices.text: Save his sister at all costs
choices.description: Rush toward the illusory Ling Yuan without hesitation, even knowing it was a trap, to save his sister. This was Chen Ji's instinct as the elder brother.
choices.visible_cost: May consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: Emotional loss of control may lead to trial failure

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes instantly bloodshot—that suppressed anger and heartache finally erupted completely. "Ling Yuan—!" He roared as he charged toward the old man in the illusion, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm erupted with unprecedented light. However, just as he was about to touch that illusory figure, the scene suddenly collapsed. Chen Nian's form dissolved into scattered motes of light, replaced by his father Chen Xuan's gentle smile. "Ji'er, you've passed."

dialogue.content: "Brother..." Chen Nian's voice came from behind him, tears streaming down her face. She had experienced the same trial in the illusion—her brother being tortured, and she was forced to hand over the research materials on the Heavenly Fate Lock. Both of them had simultaneously chosen to sacrifice themselves to protect each other, and the blood resonance formation reached an unprecedented level of alignment at this moment. "Father's trial, it turns out this was what it was testing." Chen Ji said softly, his voice somewhat hoarse.

choices.description: Suppress the anger with effort, analyzing the illusion before him with reason. The aura of the Tianji Record made him faintly sense this was a trial rather than reality, but he needed to expend more effort to resist the illusion's seduction.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may misunderstand his coldness

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to halt his steps, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve convulsing violently as if warning him of something. He closed his eyes, channeling the Tianji Record's aura to sense his surroundings—and indeed, though those images were lifelike, they lacked genuine spiritual energy fluctuations. "Illusion..." he murmured to himself, "Father's trial, what is it truly testing?" In the midst of his contemplation, Ling Yuan within the illusion wickedly increased his strength, and Chen Nian let out a shrill scream of agony. Chen Ji's jaw clenched so tightly it clicked, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth. That moment, he had truly wanted to rush over. But in the end, he relied on immense willpower to resist the illusion's temptation. The images dissolved, and his father Chen Xuan's apparition materialized before him, a glimmer of satisfaction in his gaze.

dialogue.content: "Maintaining calm judgment under such circumstances—truly a worthy son of Chen Xuan." A familiar voice suddenly rang out—it was Mo Xiansheng! In Chen Ji's mind, the guardian's remnant soul appeared for the first time of its own accord. "But remember this... sometimes emotions are also a form of strength." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried profound meaning. "The reason the Tianji Record Fragment is incomplete is precisely because it lacks this bloodline bond. And the Heavenly Fate Lock power flowing in your sister may be the key to repairing it."

text.content: After passing the first trial, the formation patterns around the altar abruptly changed. Those originally static runes began to rotate, forming a complex three-dimensional formation. Chen Ji felt the spiritual power within him being drawn by some force, creating a subtle resonance between himself, Chen Nian, and Ye Qing. "Second trial, test of power." That ancient voice rang out once more. "Three bloodline powers combined, to shatter the puppets." No sooner had the words fallen than the stone statues surrounding the altar shattered thunderously, and three puppets utterly black in color rose from the rubble, emanating a chilling oppressive aura.

"Late Nascent Soul stage!" Ye Qing's expression shifted slightly. "Moreover, three of them working in tandem, spiritual energy interconnected. This... won't be easy to deal with." Chen Ji quickly analyzed the battle situation. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm leaped, as if warning him of imminent danger. The auras of the three puppets were climbing, seemingly endless. "We must find their weakness." Chen Ji murmured. His gaze swept across the jade slip on the altar, then to the puppets forming their formation, and a plan formed in his mind. "Little Nian, use the Heavenly Fate Lock's power to disrupt their spiritual energy resonance! Ye Holy Maiden—"

choice.prompt: The battle entered a critical moment—Chen Ji must make a tactical deployment. Should he have Ye Qing use demonic path mists to cover the spiritual energy gap between the three of them and the puppets, while Chen Ji takes the opportunity to use the Tianji Record to locate and destroy the puppets' core formation?

choices.description: Have Ye Qing use demonic path mists to conceal the spiritual energy disparity between the three of them and the puppets, while Chen Ji seizes the opportunity to use the Tianji Record to locate and destroy the puppets' core formation.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing consumes a large amount of spiritual energy
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may expose the aura being tracked by the Holy Sect
choices.process_label: plan then strike, kill in one blow

text.content: Ye Qing did not hesitate. The black mist around her instantly spread, enveloping the entire altar. Within that ink-thick fog, the puppets' spiritual energy sense was completely severed. "Now!" Chen Ji shouted in a low voice, his form darting out like a specter. His palm pressed tightly against the Tianji Record Fragment, and on that fragment, the spiritual energy flow within the puppets emerged—the core was in the chest, the three puppets stood in a triangular formation, connected by a hidden line between their cores.

Chen Ji suddenly changed direction, not rushing toward the puppets, but diving straight for the hidden line connecting them. The Tianji Record Fragment erupted with a blinding silver light, slashing viciously at the hidden line. "BOOM—" A thunderous roar, and the three puppets simultaneously froze. The core formation in their chests cracked, collapsed, dissolving into scattered black mist. "Excellent strategy." Ye Qing withdrew her demonic mist, her gaze toward Chen Ji gaining a new level of genuine recognition. "You actually found the flaw in such a short time."

choices.text: Three Bloodlines unite in a single strike
choices.description: Abandoning any clever tactics, the three directly confront the puppets with bloodline power. This is the most direct clash, yet it best showcases the bond between the three siblings.
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline power is stimulated, generating resonance with the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May trigger instability in the Tianji Record

text.content: "No need to search!" Chen Ji suddenly shouted. "Little Nian, lend me your Heavenly Fate Lock Key power! Our three bloodlines share the same origin—nothing is more direct than bloodline power to break this formation!" A flicker of hesitation crossed Chen Nian's eyes before transforming into unwavering resolve. She extended her hand, clasping Chen Ji's tightly. After a moment of silence, Ye Qing placed her hand atop theirs. Three distinctly different powers merged into an unprecedented torrent.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with heat, its damaged pages beginning to heal themselves. Characters writhed across the surface like living beings, finally settling into content Chen Ji had never before witnessed: "The Heavenly Fate Lock Key, bloodline unity, can mend Heavenly Secrets' flaws." His eyes widened in shock—how could the method to repair the Tianji Record have been hidden within his sister all along? "Father... he orchestrated this from the very beginning," Chen Ji murmured, awe and reverence threading through his voice.

Following the puppets' dissolution, the jade slip atop the altar erupted with resplendent light, hovering mid-air as it gradually unfurled. Across its surface, golden characters glimmered like flowing water—Chen Xuan's handwriting, each word imbued with a father's profound affection and unfulfilled aspirations for his children. "My sons Chen Ji, Chen Nian, Chen An..." The opening line alone made Chen Ji's heart seize. Father had even inscribed Second Brother's name. "Three Bloodlines Trial, passed." That elderly voice resonated once more, now carrying threads of tenderness. "Now, the final trial awaits."

At the altar's center, a luminous pillar surged skyward. Within its radiance, a familiar figure gradually took shape—an middle-aged man with refined features, scholarly bearing, bearing a striking resemblance to Chen Ji. "Ji'er..." Chen Xuan's phantom spoke with gentle warmth, "You've finally arrived." Chen Ji's entire being trembled. The father whose visage had grown distant in memory now stood vividly before him. "Father," his voice emerged hoarse, nearly inaudible, "Have you... have you been waiting here for us all this time?"

dialogue.content: "This is merely a remnant of your father's will," Chen Xuan's phantom explained with a serene smile, one so tender it ached. "The true me departed long ago. Yet certain truths demand direct revelation." His gaze swept across Chen Nian, paused on Ye Qing, then settled upon Chen Ji. "Tianji Record's restoration requires Heavenly Fate Lock Key power. And the fourth layer's seal..." He hesitated, seemingly wrestling with immense pressure. "Only through the unification of three bloodlines can it be opened."

text.content: "Unification of three bloodlines?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed. "Second Brother Chen An vanished years ago, his trace completely lost. Gathering three bloodlines seems impossible." Chen Xuan's phantom shook his head. "An'er still lives." The words detonated like thunder in the silent altar. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; Chen Nian even cried out, "Second Brother is alive?!" Chen Xuan's phantom began to fade, clearly unable to sustain itself much longer. "The Holy Sect... they took him. Shortly after I left you all... Ji'er, seek him out. The key to Tianji Record's fourth layer seal rests upon him."

"Father!" Chen Ji surged forward, attempting to grasp the dissolving figure, only to grasp empty air. Chen Xuan's phantom channeled his final vestiges of power into a warm token, which settled steadily into Chen Ji's palm. "This represents your father's ultimate gift. Possessing this token grants one entry into the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds." His gaze lingered on Chen Nian. "Little Nian, care for your eldest brother." Chen Nian was already sobbing. "Father..." Before completely fading, Chen Xuan's phantom cast one last look at his children, eyes overflowing with longing and reluctance. "In this life, I have wronged you deeply. But the Ye family's destiny... I now entrust to you..."

dialogue.content: The light pillar completely dissipated, Chen Xuan's image forever frozen in that moment. Chen Nian knelt on the ground, tears sliding silently. Chen Ji stood motionless, clutching the token still carrying his father's warmth, in profound silence. "Young Master Chen." Ye Qing's voice drifted from behind, low and serious. "It seems... our next destination is the Holy Sect." She paused. "But before that, you might need proper rest. Some burdens cannot be borne alone." Chen Ji did not turn, slowly placing the token into his robe, his voice eerily calm. "Rest? With Second Brother suffering in the Holy Sect, how could I possibly rest?"

text.content: Upon the altar, the jade slip descended gently, settling securely into Chen Ji's palm. He gazed downward, discovering an inscribed map on its reverse side—a route leading to the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. At the journey's end, a symbol he'd never encountered marked the destination. The mark mirrored the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment, yet carried inexplicable mystical depth. "Father..." Chen Ji murmured, pressing the jade slip close to his heart. "Rest assured, I shall accomplish Second Brother's cause. Ling Yuan's debt, I shall also collect in full." His gaze gradually hardened to ice-cold sharpness. "Tianqing Sect, Holy Sect, Xuanwu Sect... Since you wish to play, I shall accompany you until the very end." Ye Qing observed his silhouette, for the first time truly perceiving this man's terrifying nature—beneath that gentle exterior lurked a heart ruthless enough to shake the entire world.
